verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. Both have the same flaws. The three price cards are shrunk to tiny chips: the MONTHLY/YEARLY/FAMILY labels and the 'per month'/'per year' text can't be read, and the cards are reordered to 6/80/48, which breaks the original sequence. The subhead and legal copy are jammed into a cramped stack against the right edge, and the fine print is about as large as the subhead. The logo is undersized and floats on its own at the left.
